purpose: Local/manual live-training calibration record. Raw personal observations are not committed to Divine Knowledge by default.

example.notes: Synthetic example only; do not treat as live evidence.

fieldRules.observationId: Local unique identifier; need not contain player identity.
fieldRules.capturedAt: Offset-aware timestamp preferred for raw local evidence; aggregate repository summaries may omit it.
fieldRules.source: Record where each value came from. Do not silently upgrade displayed precision.
fieldRules.stat.beforeDisplayed: Record exactly what the chosen source provides. Site-wide whole-number display is acceptable for initial calibration and is presentation-quantized.
fieldRules.happy.quarterHourCrossed: Must be false for ordinary eligible S/B/H evidence.
fieldRules.gym.name: Human-readable identity if known. Synthetic/aggregate repository records may omit names when dots and energy cost are sufficient.
fieldRules.gym.dots: Normalized familiar gym-dot scale, not API ten-times gain value.
fieldRules.gym.energyPerTrain: Positive integer energy consumed by one internal train.
fieldRules.trainCount: 1 for Class S primary evidence; >1 for Class B.
fieldRules.gainDisplayed.value: Copy Torn's success-message gain exactly as displayed.
fieldRules.gainDisplayed.decimalPlaces: Record actual display precision. Official Gym patch history records a two-decimal gym-gain display change; current rounding versus truncation is not assumed until live-verified.
fieldRules.gainPerks: Explicit known gain multipliers only, with unique stable IDs and decimal rates.
fieldRules.specialEffects: Any effect whose placement/rounding may alter gain or Happy loss. Nonempty unresolved effects move the observation to Class X/quarantine.
fieldRules.dataQuality.modifierSnapshotComplete: False means the observation cannot be primary model-fit evidence until resolved.

derivedAnalysis.displayGainInterval: Until display rounding is proven, use [D-0.01,D+0.01] for a two-decimal gym gain.
derivedAnalysis.energySpentCheck: energy.before - energy.after should equal trainCount * gym.energyPerTrain unless another documented energy event occurred.
derivedAnalysis.happyLossCheck: happy.before - happy.after is evaluated separately from gain fit.
derivedAnalysis.inferredNoiseInterval: For Class S under vladar-v2-pre50m-v1, derive from the observed gain interval using CALIBRATION-PROTOCOL-001B.md.
derivedAnalysis.eligibility: Quarter-hour crossing, unknown modifiers, ambiguous transcription, or intervening actions quarantine the record rather than being silently ignored.
